scope: Public supported-source snapshot; no private local Git history or data payload
excluded_categories: Archives and imported historical audit trees
Individual-patient result summaries and cohort configuration tables
Installed tools, containers, sequencing/reference/result payloads and caches
export_policy: Replace site-specific absolute path prefixes and coded identifiers in documentation examples with explicit templates; preserve local source and scientific settings

export_transformations.coded_identifiers_in_documentation_examp: Replaced by SAMPLE_01-style labels; no clinical values or specimen tables exported
